All modules

daycard

sections · 0.1.0 · aj-s-daycard

The Timeline's date and mood card (v4 C1): the date row, which unrolls the calendar over what is under the card; the mood row ("Mood", the week's name, a strip of the week's seven days, the week arrows while the panel is open); the mood panel with the week's graph. Both parts start closed. Every way to a day (a strip dot, a graph point, a calendar day) is one jump.

contentdaytext, required
contentdatetext, required

contentshowntext

contentidtext

statedefaultyes: both parts closed: the date row above the mood row, the week as a strip of seven dots
statehoveryes: the date and the mood name underline and their arrows tint; a strip dot takes a wash (its controls' own)
statefocus-visiblen/a: its controls carry the product focus ring
stateactiven/a: its controls act at once
statedisabledyes: an arrow with no week that way is off (30% --rule)
stateselectedyes: the mood panel open (the graph, the arrows instead of the strip); the calendar open (unrolled from the date)
stateloadingn/a: drawn from the days the page has
stateerrorn/a: nothing here can fail
stateemptyyes: nothing written this week: the strip's empty rings and the empty graph; this week is always there
usesmoodgraph0.x
usescal0.x

Closed

At rest: the date row above the mood row, the week as a strip of seven dots; both parts closed.
